title: Edit a draft intervention line
steps: Inspect draft intervention FI1007-0002 for Indian SAS and its Pres line.
Scroll down to view the Pres line and the Validate, Clone, and Delete record actions.
Click the pencil beside Pres, wait for the line editor, then inspect Save, Cancel, and the record-action area beneath it.

video_guide.summary: The draft intervention enters existing-line editing. Save and Cancel remain available while the record-level actions disappear.

chapters.note: Draft intervention FI1007-0002 is open with the Pres line.
The view scrolls to the Pres pencil and enabled Validate, Clone, and Delete actions.
The existing Pres line editor shows Save and Cancel; the record-level action row is absent.
The area below the editor no longer offers the record-level actions.
